source.note: Placeholder, not a historical value.
Placeholder: morale of a fresh squad; the scale is 0 to 100.
Placeholder: morale lost per second at squad suppression 100 (linear in the squad level).
Placeholder: morale lost per man down, times a random spread and times (1 + share of the squad lost).
Placeholder: lowest random factor on a casualty shock.
Placeholder: highest random factor on a casualty shock.
Placeholder: extra morale lost when the squad leader goes down.
Placeholder: share of each shock that a squad with friendly support nearby does not take.
Placeholder: recovery ceiling lost with 100% of the squad down (linear).
Placeholder: recovery ceiling lost while the squad has no effective leader.
Placeholder: recovery ceiling lost while no friendly squad is within the support radius.
Placeholder: recovery ceiling lost while the squad is out of contact with an HQ.
Placeholder: morale lost per second while above the recovery ceiling.
Placeholder: morale regained per second toward the ceiling while not under fire.
Placeholder: recovery is multiplied by (1 + leader bonus x this + the bonuses below).
Placeholder: added to the recovery multiplier with friendly support nearby.
Placeholder: added to the recovery multiplier with an HQ of the side within the rally radius.
Placeholder: a friendly squad this close (between able-men centres) supports the squad.
Placeholder: an HQ of the side this close helps the squad rally.
Placeholder: no recovery for this long after the squad loses a man.
Placeholder: how long the LeaderKilled reason shows after the leader went down.
Placeholder: share of the squad down from which the reason is HeavyCasualties.
Placeholder: a steady squad below this is Shaken.
Placeholder: a shaken squad at or above this is Steady again.
Placeholder: a squad below this is Broken.
Placeholder: a broken or routing squad at or above this, while recovering, is Rallying.
Placeholder: a broken squad below this routs.
Placeholder: a rallying squad at or above this (or at its ceiling, if lower) has rallied.
Placeholder: how far a routing squad runs from the nearest known enemy.
Placeholder: a routing squad runs from the mean bearing of the known enemies within this distance.
Placeholder: a broken or routing squad with a man this close to a shell burst cowers flat where it is (owner decision: cower first).
Placeholder: it bolts only after this long with no burst within cower_radius (the shelling lifts or slackens).
